description: Chat Polish and Documentation: enhances AI chat with syntax-highlighted code blocks, copy-to-clipboard buttons, message timestamps, and updates frontend documentation. Modifies AIPage.tsx to parse code blocks from assistant messages, adds CodeBlock component with copy functionality, displays timestamps. Updates README.md and .env.example with complete feature documentation. Depends on FEAT-004 (AIPage with tabs).
steps: 1. Read existing src/pages/ai/AIPage.tsx message rendering logic in .markdown-content section. Currently uses simple p tags for each line split by \n.

2. Create renderMessageContent helper function in AIPage.tsx: takes content string, uses regex /```(\w+)? ([\s\S]*?)```/g to detect code blocks (```language code ```). Returns array of React nodes: text before code block as

, code block as component, remaining text as

.

3. Create CodeBlock component inside AIPage.tsx (not separate file): takes code (string) and language (string) props. useState for copied (boolean). copyToClipboard function uses navigator.clipboard.writeText(code), sets copied true for 2s. Render: div.code-block-wrapper with header (language label, copy button with Copy/Check icon from lucide-react) and 
{code}
.

4. Add code block styles to src/pages/ai/AIPage.css: .code-block-wrapper (margin 0.75rem 0, border-radius 6px, overflow hidden, border 1px solid #ddd). .code-block-header (display flex, justify-content space-between, padding 0.5rem 0.75rem, background #2d2d2d, color #fff, font-size 0.75rem). .code-language (text-transform uppercase, font-weight 600). .copy-button (display flex, align-items center, gap 0.25rem, background rgba(255,255,255,0.1), border none, color #fff, padding 0.25rem 0.5rem, border-radius 4px, cursor pointer, font-size 0.75rem, transition background 0.2s). .copy-button:hover (background rgba(255,255,255,0.2)). .code-block (margin 0, padding 1rem, background #1e1e1e, color #d4d4d4, font-family Monaco/Menlo/monospace, font-size 0.85rem, overflow-x auto).

5. Update message rendering in AIPage.tsx: for assistant messages, replace current .markdown-content content with {renderMessageContent(message.content)}. Import Copy and Check icons from lucide-react.

6. Add timestamp display: after .message-content div, add conditional render: {message.createdAt && (
{new Date(message.createdAt).toLocaleTimeString()}
)}. Add .message-timestamp style to AIPage.css (font-size 0.7rem, color var(--color-muted), margin-top 0.25rem, text-align right). For user messages, add .user-message .message-timestamp (color rgba(255,255,255,0.7)).
7. Verify frontend/.env.example exists and contains: VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080/api with comment explaining it's the backend API base URL.

8. Update frontend/README.md: replace content with comprehensive documentation covering: Features (role-based dashboards, GitHub OAuth, repository import, semantic code search, AI chat with code blocks), Stack (React 19, TypeScript 6, Vite 8, Axios, React Router, Lucide React, React Toastify), Quick Start (npm install, copy .env.example, npm run dev), Environment Variables (VITE_API_BASE_URL), Routes (public: /login, /register, /github/callback; protected candidate/recruiter: /dashboard, /profile, /github, /ai/:projectId?; admin: /admin/dashboard, /admin/users), GitHub OAuth Setup (create OAuth app, set callback URL, configure backend env vars), Development Commands (install, dev, build, preview, lint), Project Structure (directory tree with explanations), Styling (CSS variables, reusable classes), Backend Integration (API endpoints summary).

9. Add responsive adjustments if needed: code blocks already have overflow-x auto for mobile. Test copy button works on mobile devices (may not work on all browsers due to clipboard API restrictions).
